events.name: Christmas Photobooth
events.description: A slow phone shot down two sepia photobooth strips of you and your best friend, a new pose in every photo, to Last Christmas.

events.name: Couple Cliff Prank
events.description: On a grey sea cliff, one partner yells from the far end of a wooden plank over the drop; the calm one in the long black coat gives one cold stare, steps back off the plank, and the yeller drops into the air.

events.name: Darts 170 Prank
events.description: A split screen from a packed darts arena: the dartboard on top takes three darts in the red bull while the player in the black polo below throws them, then turns and roars at the camera as the crowd jumps up.

events.name: I'm Not Yo B No More Dance
events.description: In a grey office, a worker in a white short-sleeve shirt, navy tie, tan suspenders and khakis breaks into a full-power club dance (fists up by the head, stomping knee lifts, low lunges, arms flung wide) while coworkers sit and watch.

events.name: iPhone Kupi Dance
events.description: In a dark hotel room at night you flip a folding phone open to the lens, lean right in, open a second, tablet-size folding phone across the frame, then step back and dance wildly, tossing it into the air.

events.name: Kakalika Dance
events.description: You and two friends do the Kakalika dance in a bright marble hallway: bouncy steps, big side kicks, a turn round and back, a lean back and arms up to the sky, one full-length take.

events.name: Passenger Princess
events.description: The passenger princess goes off duty: an iced coffee handed to the driver, a neck pillow tucked in, sunglasses on and a blanket up to the chin, while the driver just smiles at the road.

events.name: She Kisses My Boo Boos
events.description: You at your normal height, smiling at the camera, holding your partner on your hip: they're shrunk to miniature size but still a grown adult, with their own face, beard, cap and clothes.
